comment: Rules for allocating building-related costs between landlord and tenant (DE_2024 ruleset, cost_spec.md §6.2-§6.4). This file defines the legal parameters that determine which costs can be passed on to a tenant and which remain the landlord's responsibility: the apportionable share of maintenance (BetrKV), the modernization levy that converts part of an investment into a permanent rent increase (§559/§559e BGB, with its caps), and the tiered split of the CO2 price on heating emissions (CO2KostAufG). The rules are jurisdiction- and year-specific and are represented as data so the billing engine (hisim/economics/actors.py) can apply them consistently; percentages and caps reflect the law as of 2024 and are to be verified in a legal review pass before release (cost_module_issues.md #10).

modernization_levy.heating_measure_component_types_comment: ComponentType names levied under §559e instead of §559 (cost_spec.md §6.4, D27): heat-supply measures that satisfy the §71 GEG 65-%-renewable options - electric heat pump (§71 Abs. 3 Nr. 2), connection to a heat network (Nr. 1), solar thermal (§71e), biomass boilers (§71g) - plus the heat storage installed as part of such a measure. Deliberately excluded and therefore levied at 8 %: fossil gas and oil boilers (not §71-compliant), hydrogen-ready and direct-electric heating (compliant only under further conditions this engine does not model), heat emitters and the whole building envelope.
